# Emotion Beater 🧘
**Developed by KASHITAA**

Emotion Beater is a mental health gamification app built with React Native and Expo. 
It uses the Groq Llama-3 AI to provide supportive feedback and suggests mood-based games.

## Features
- AI-Powered Mood Detection
- Evolutionary Avatar (🌱 -> 🧘)
- Integrated Poki Games for Mood Regulation
- Private Analytics & Daily Missions
